safe.q: Is IBADA safe for kids and pets?
safe.a: Yes. IBADA uses no chemicals, sprays or poisons — nothing to touch, inhale or swallow, and the sound it makes is inaudible to people. As with any ultrasonic device, we don't recommend using it in the same room as pet rodents such as hamsters, guinea pigs or rabbits.

coverage.q: How much area does one device cover?
coverage.a: Each device covers up to 50m² of open space. Ultrasound doesn't pass through walls or closed doors, so we recommend one device per room — that's why our packs protect 2, 3 or 4 rooms.

results.q: How long until I notice a difference?
results.a: IBADA drives pests away gradually. Keep it plugged in continuously, day and night, and let it work over time.

payment.a: You pay in cash when your order arrives. No card needed and nothing to pay online.

delivery.a: Orders are typically delivered in 2–4 business days anywhere in Lebanon. We call you to confirm your order before it ships.

guarantee.q: What if it doesn't work for me?
guarantee.a: You're covered by our 60-day money-back guarantee. Contact us and we'll arrange the return and your refund.

power.a: Any standard 220V wall socket, indoors. There is nothing to install or set up.
